notes: Validated against Smith et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2009 (doi:10.1038/nsmb.1702) and Kang et al. PNAS 2012. c-di-GMP is recognised asymmetrically by the monomeric riboswitch. A47 is the single most critical residue — it intercalates between both guanine bases of c-di-GMP, creating a continuous 3-base stack (Gα–A47–Gβ). G20 Hoogsteen-pairs with Gα; C92 Watson-Crick-pairs with Gβ. Metal coordination: Gα 5′-phosphate coordinated by a hydrated Mg²⁺ (outer-sphere); Gβ 5′-phosphate makes inner-sphere contact to a second Mg²⁺. Mg also contacts G19 and G20 to stabilise the binding pocket.
